buttons.label: Next doorway side
buttons.script: const castle=objects.getAll('castle')[0]; const plan=castle.definition.buildPlan.metadata.runtime; const doors=[...plan.roomDoors,{...plan.residential.origin,roomId:'main-entrance'}]; const index=(map.auditView??-1)+1; map.auditView=index%(doors.length*2); const door=doors[Math.floor(map.auditView/2)]; const side=map.auditView%2?1:-1; const angle=door.yaw*Math.PI/180; const hero=objects.getOne('hero'); camera.setFirstPerson(false); hero.teleport({x:door.x+Math.sin(angle)*side*1.35,y:door.y+0.014,z:door.z+Math.cos(angle)*side*1.35}); hero.firstPersonCameraEnabled=true; hero.firstPersonFacingYaw=door.yaw+(side>0?180:0); camera.setFirstPerson(true);

buttons.label: View wall decoration
buttons.script: const prop=[...objects].find(o=>["RoyalCrest","WarCouncilShield"].includes(o.constructor.name)); if (!prop) return; const p=prop.definition.position; const angle=prop.definition.rotation*Math.PI/180; const forward=2.8; const lateral=0; const x=p.x+Math.sin(angle)*forward+Math.cos(angle)*lateral; const z=p.z+Math.cos(angle)*forward-Math.sin(angle)*lateral; const hero=objects.getOne("hero"); camera.setFirstPerson(false); hero.teleport({x,y:p.y-2.15+0.014,z}); hero.firstPersonCameraEnabled=true; hero.firstPersonFacingYaw=Math.atan2(p.x-x,p.z-z)*180/Math.PI; camera.setFirstPerson(true);

buttons.label: Oblique wall view
buttons.script: const prop=[...objects].find(o=>["RoyalCrest","WarCouncilShield"].includes(o.constructor.name)); if (!prop) return; const p=prop.definition.position; const angle=prop.definition.rotation*Math.PI/180; const forward=2.8; const lateral=0.7; const x=p.x+Math.sin(angle)*forward+Math.cos(angle)*lateral; const z=p.z+Math.cos(angle)*forward-Math.sin(angle)*lateral; const hero=objects.getOne("hero"); camera.setFirstPerson(false); hero.teleport({x,y:p.y-2.15+0.014,z}); hero.firstPersonCameraEnabled=true; hero.firstPersonFacingYaw=Math.atan2(p.x-x,p.z-z)*180/Math.PI; camera.setFirstPerson(true);
